_comment: Config + scenario matrix for smoke.py. See README.md in this directory. S1-S8 were the original phase-A rows against the 0.8.4 five-module topology (weapon still a Gangland module, no Bartizan, no civilians/npcshops split) -- kept for reference and still dry-run-verifiable, but marked "legacy": true (T-O9, 0.9.0) since they no longer describe the shipped topology; smoke.py's --list labels them. D0-D9 are the phase-D matrix for the post-split topology (gangland-0.9.0.md section G6 / REVIEW-consistency.md 'Smoke rows for phase D'), added by T-O9. Two items from the original S-row table were intentionally NOT encoded as automated checks and that limitation carries over identically to the D-rows: a DB-level check (S4's 'detainment table migrates') and a count/second-pass check that needs a human read of the transcript rather than a substring match (S1's '/glw help lists only core commands', and likewise D8's 'no second Item vocabularies installed: line' and 'no duplicate-listener errors', which need a COUNT-of-occurrences check evaluate_expect() does not implement) -- see smoke/README.md's Limitations section. D6's counted fault totals reflect the checklist's default reading (civilians/copsncrooks/gadget skipped, turf still loads); gangland-0.9.0.md's own D6 row flags this as PENDING A USER DECISION (reviews H m8 / RI I-3) -- if civilians' Plugins:[Bartizan] edge is later reworked so turf no longer transitively needs Bartizan, D6 stays correct only under variant (a) (accept the coupling); under variant (b) turf would also skip (2 loaded, 4 fault(s), no 'Item vocabularies installed: none' -> still applies, 'Depends' fault instead) and this row's expect block needs re-deriving, not just re-running. | 2026-09-17: paths point at the decoupling-wave worktrees (gangland-0.9.2, keystone-1.10.0, bartizan-0.4.0); the main checkouts hold an unrelated uncommitted floor wave. | 2026-10-05 (T10, cnc 0.15): paths repointed to the integration worktree gangland-0.15.0 + Keystone 1.14.0 + Bartizan 0.6.1 (api-compatible with the 0.6.0 pin); healthbars prefix added; row cnc-015-boot added (nine modules).

legacy_module_jar_prefix._comment: T-O9: 'weapon' dropped from module_jar_prefix (there is no gangland-weapon module in the 0.9.0 topology D0-D9 target) but kept here so the 'legacy': true S1-S8 rows -- which still reference module id 'weapon' -- stay dry-run-verifiable against the pre-split 0.8.4 layout. smoke.py's module_prefix() checks module_jar_prefix first, this map second.
